What this does

1.  Loads the KAZA `lcmixed` steps and checks columns
2.  Builds the KAZA ephemeral-river lines (HydroRIVERS, catchment \>=
    1,000 km2, discharge \< 10 m3/s, same rule as West)
3.  Makes 500 m distance rasters for the new fences and the ephemeral
    rivers, then extracts at step endpoints (`fence_dist` must be
    rebuilt: the old one came from the old fence layer)
4.  Recounts crossings by **vector intersection** (step line touches
    feature line) for fences, perennial rivers, ephemeral rivers, and
    roads if a road vector exists
5.  Fits the model set, compares by AIC/BIC, reports exp(coef) with 95%
    CI, and runs the step-length check

```{r setup}
here::i_am("code/linear_features_ssf_kaza.Rmd")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(survival)
if (!requireNamespace("sfheaders", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sfheaders")
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

```{r build-lcmixed}
## 0. Build _lcmixed files (skips if already present)
#Only needed if the `_lcmixed.rds` files aren't in `outputs/`

#Regenerating needs `extract_lc_mixed()` from
#`code/etosha_ssf.Rmd` and `library(amt)`
for (s in c("wet", "dry")) {
  out <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, "_lcmixed.rds"))
  if (file.exists(out)) { cat(s, "already done\n"); next }

  d  <- readRDS(here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, ".rds")))
  n0 <- nrow(d)

  d <- d |>
    select(-any_of(c("cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "water_rivers_dist"))) |>  # re-extracted (identical)
    extract_lc_mixed()

  stopifnot(nrow(d) == n0)                                                      # no rows lost
  cat(s, "rows:", nrow(d), "| binary NAs:",
      colSums(is.na(d[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")])), "\n")
  saveRDS(d, out)
  rm(d); gc()
}
```

```{r paths}
STEP_FILES <- c(
  wet = here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet_lcmixed.rds"),
  dry = here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_lcmixed.rds")
)

FENCE_RAST   <- here("data", "Linear_features", "all_vet_fences", "vetfences_all_500m.tif")
FENCE_DIST   <- here("data", "Linear_features", "all_vet_fences", "dist_vetfences_500m.tif")
FENCE_VEC    <- NULL
HR_AFRICA    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "HydroRIVERS_v10_af.gdb", "HydroRIVERS_v10_af.gdb")  
HR_LAYER     <- st_layers(HR_AFRICA)$name[1]                                           # HydroRIVERS_v10_af
PERENNIAL    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "hydrorivers_namibia_gte5.shp")       # current river layer (covers KAZA to 25.5E)
ROAD_PATH    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "roads_selected_exported.shp")       # road vector -> line-intersection road crossings
# Not KAZA_vet_fences_exported.shp: that's the OLD fence layer (Sep), the one with almost nothing in KAZA's range
STRATA_COL   <- "step_id"    
MIN_USED_CROSS <- 50         # minimum used-step crossings per season to estimate a crossing term

stopifnot(all(file.exists(STEP_FILES)), file.exists(FENCE_RAST), file.exists(FENCE_DIST),
          dir.exists(HR_AFRICA), file.exists(PERENNIAL), file.exists(ROAD_PATH))

# KAZA steps are in lon/lat (EPSG:4326), the same as fence rasters.
crs_steps    <- "EPSG:4326"
fence_r      <- rast(FENCE_RAST)
fence_dist_r <- rast(FENCE_DIST)            # metres (max ~311 km)
tmpl         <- fence_r
stopifnot(same.crs(fence_r, crs_steps), compareGeom(fence_r, fence_dist_r, stopOnError = FALSE))
print(freq(fence_r))                        # 1 = fence, 0 = not

# Line-on-line intersection in degrees: planar (GEOS) is fine for 1-hr steps and much faster than s2
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}

pick_col <- function(d, opts) {
  hit <- intersect(opts, names(d))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("None of these columns found: ", paste(opts, collapse = ", "))
  hit[1]
}

standardize_cols <- function(d) {
  map <- c(x1_ = pick_col(d, c("x1_", "x1")), y1_ = pick_col(d, c("y1_", "y1")),
           x2_ = pick_col(d, c("x2_", "x2")), y2_ = pick_col(d, c("y2_", "y2")),
           case_ = pick_col(d, c("case_", "case")), sl_ = pick_col(d, c("sl_", "sl")))
  # coordinates are degrees, so amt's sl_ is in degrees too. Step length in metres (good approximation at 1-hr steps):
  d |> rename(any_of(setNames(map, names(map)))) |>
    mutate(sl_m = sqrt(((x2_ - x1_) * 111320 * cos((y1_ + y2_) / 2 * pi / 180))^2 +
                       ((y2_ - y1_) * 110574)^2),
           log_sl_m = log(pmax(sl_m, 1)))
}

# Step lines in batches -> TRUE if the step line intersects any feature line
cross_vec <- function(d, lines, batch = 250000) {
  out <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]   # zero-length / NA steps can't cross
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(lines))
      out[ok] <- lengths(st_intersects(sl, lines)) > 0
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  as.integer(out)
}

# Raster version of a crossing, for when there's no fence vector.
# any    = step line passes through a fence cell (what the old 500 m method did; blends proximity)
# strict = passes through a fence cell AND neither endpoint is in a fence cell
#          (removes steps that end on, or walk along, the fence; can miss real crossings that end right past it)
cross_rast <- function(d, r, batch = 250000) {
  is_fence <- function(v) !is.na(v) & v > 0
  any_ <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(crs_steps))
      e <- terra::extract(r, vect(sl), fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)
      any_[ok] <- is_fence(e[, 2])
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  start_in <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x1_, d$y1_))[, 1])
  end_in   <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_))[, 1])
  tibble(any = as.integer(any_), strict = as.integer(any_ & !start_in & !end_in))
}

# Rasterize lines on the 500 m template, then distance (m) to nearest line cell
dist_raster <- function(lines) {
  r <- rasterize(vect(lines), tmpl, touches = TRUE)
  distance(r)
}

prep_lines <- function(x, bbox_sf) {
  x |> st_zm() |> st_transform(crs_steps) |>
    st_filter(bbox_sf) |> select(any_of(c("HYRIV_ID", "UPLAND_SKM", "DIS_AV_CMS")))
}
```

## Checkpoint 1: steps load, columns, bad fixes

Load one file at a time (both at once crashed R last time).

```{r check-steps}
bb_all <- NULL
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  stopifnot(STRATA_COL %in% names(d))
  cat("\n==", s, "==  rows:", nrow(d), " strata:", n_distinct(d[[STRATA_COL]]), "\n")
  print(table(d$case_))

  # Bad collar fixes: used 1-hr steps > 8 km. MET23/MET42 caused West's wet-season artifact.
  cat("sl_ range (degrees?):", round(range(d$sl_, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "  sl_m median (m):", round(median(d$sl_m[d$case_ == 1], na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
  bad <- d |> filter(case_ == 1, sl_m > 8000)
  cat("Used steps > 8 km:", nrow(bad), "\n")
  if (nrow(bad) > 0 && "id" %in% names(d)) print(count(bad, id, sort = TRUE))
  if (any(c("MET23", "MET42") %in% d$id)) warning("MET23/MET42 present in KAZA ", s, ": inspect before fitting")

  bb_s <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = min(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymin = min(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE),
                              xmax = max(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymax = max(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))
  bb_all <- if (is.null(bb_all)) bb_s else st_union(bb_all, bb_s)
  rm(d); gc()
}
b <- st_bbox(bb_all)
bb_kaza <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = b[["xmin"]] - 0.2, ymin = b[["ymin"]] - 0.2,
                               xmax = b[["xmax"]] + 0.2, ymax = b[["ymax"]] + 0.2),
                             crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))   # ~20 km margin
```

**Stop here if** there are many \> 8 km used steps concentrated in one
or two collars. Drop those fixes and regenerate steps before going on.

## Build the feature lines

```{r lines}
fences    <- if (!is.null(FENCE_VEC)) st_read(FENCE_VEC, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza) else NULL
perennial <- st_read(PERENNIAL,  quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)


if (exists("read_hr") && exists("bb_kaza_hr")) {
  ephemeral <- read_hr(bb_kaza_hr, min_upland = 1000) |>
    filter(DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)
} else {
  bb_ll <- st_as_text(st_transform(bb_kaza, 4326))
  ephemeral <- st_read(HR_AFRICA, layer = HR_LAYER, wkt_filter = bb_ll, quiet = TRUE) |>
    filter(UPLAND_SKM >= 1000, DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)
}
roads <- if (!is.null(ROAD_PATH)) st_read(ROAD_PATH, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza) else NULL

fence_cells_kaza <- global(crop(fence_r, vect(bb_kaza)) > 0, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
cat("Fence cells in KAZA extent:", fence_cells_kaza, " fence vector:", if (is.null(fences)) "none (raster crossings)" else nrow(fences),
    " perennial:", nrow(perennial), " ephemeral:", nrow(ephemeral),
    " roads:", if (is.null(roads)) "raster kept" else nrow(roads), "\n")
stopifnot(fence_cells_kaza > 0, nrow(ephemeral) > 0)

st_write(ephemeral, here("data", "Linear_features", "kaza_ephemeral_rivers_hydrorivers_1k.gpkg"),
         delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```

## Checkpoint 2: map before extracting

Look at what the discharge \< 10 filter picks up in KAZA.
Okavango/Chobe/Zambezi floodplain channels that hold water seasonally
aren't "ephemeral" the way West's riverbeds are. If you see a lot of
them, rename the term for KAZA or note it.

```{r map, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
fence_pts <- crop(fence_r, vect(bb_kaza)) |> as.points() |> st_as_sf()
names(fence_pts)[1] <- "v"
fence_pts <- filter(fence_pts, v > 0)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ephemeral, colour = "goldenrod", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = perennial, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = fence_pts, colour = "red", size = 0.2) +
  coord_sf(crs = crs_steps) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "KAZA: new fences (red), perennial rivers (blue), ephemeral rivers (gold)")
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "kaza_v2_linear_features.png"), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 200)
```

## Distance rasters and extraction

```{r dist-rasters}
# fence_dist_r comes straight from Marissa's dist_vetfences_500m.tif (loaded in `paths`)
eph_dist_r   <- dist_raster(ephemeral)
writeRaster(eph_dist_r,  here("data", "Linear_features", "kaza_ephemeral_rivers_dist_1k_500m.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r extract}
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n==", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  xy <- cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_)

  # keep the old raster-based values for comparison
  d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(fence_dist_old = "fence_dist", fence_cross_r500 = "fence_cross",
                            river_cross_r500 = "river_cross")))

  # endpoint distances (km, so coefficients are readable; match however your other dist terms are scaled)
  d$fence_dist             <- terra::extract(fence_dist_r, xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_dist  <- terra::extract(eph_dist_r,  xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_prox  <- exp(-d$ephemeral_rivers_dist)   # = exp(-d_m / 1000), same as West

  # vector crossings
  cat("fences\n")
  if (!is.null(fences)) {
    d$fence_cross <- cross_vec(d, fences)
  } else {
    fc <- cross_rast(d, fence_r)
    d$fence_cross_any <- fc$any
    d$fence_cross     <- fc$strict   # model uses strict; compare counts with _any and _r500 at checkpoint 3
  }
  cat("perennial\n"); d$river_cross     <- cross_vec(d, perennial)
  cat("ephemeral\n"); d$ephemeral_cross <- cross_vec(d, ephemeral)
  if (!is.null(roads)) {
    d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(road_cross_r500 = "road_cross")))
    cat("roads\n"); d$road_cross <- cross_vec(d, roads)
  }

  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$fence_dist), !anyNA(d$ephemeral_rivers_dist))
  saveRDS(d, here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  rm(d); gc()
}
```

## Checkpoint 3: crossing counts and collinearity

```{r check-cross}
cross_summary <- map_dfr(names(STEP_FILES), function(s) {
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  out <- d |>
    select(case_, any_of(c("fence_cross", "fence_cross_any", "fence_cross_r500","river_cross", "river_cross_r500",
                           "ephemeral_cross", "road_cross"))) |>
    pivot_longer(-case_, names_to = "term", values_to = "x") |>
    group_by(term, case_) |> summarise(n_cross = sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), rate = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = case_, values_from = c(n_cross, rate), names_glue = "{.value}_{ifelse(case_ == 1, 'used', 'random')}") |>
    mutate(season = s, ratio_used_random = rate_used / rate_random)
  rm(d); gc(); out
})
cross_summary |> arrange(term, season) |> print(n = Inf)
```

How to read it: `ratio_used_random` near 1 means no barrier, well below
1 means a barrier. Vector counts should be **lower** than the `_r500`
versions (the raster counted near-misses). Any term with fewer than
`MIN_USED_CROSS` used crossings in a season gets dropped from that
season's model below.

```{r check-cor}
d <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_v2.rds")) |> slice_sample(n = 200000)
cand <- intersect(c("ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross", "water_rivers_dist",
                    "river_cross", "road_cross", "road_dist", "fence_dist", "fence_cross"), names(d))
cm <- cor(d[, cand], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(round(cm, 2))
flag <- which(abs(cm) > 0.6 & upper.tri(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(flag)) { cat("\n|r| > 0.6:\n"); print(tibble(a = rownames(cm)[flag[, 1]], b = colnames(cm)[flag[, 2]], r = cm[flag])) }
rm(d); gc()
```

Kaza habitat terms 

## Fit models

**Match `hab_terms` to the KAZA main model in
`kaza_ssf_linear_features.Rmd`.** This is my reading of your last
output.

```{r fit}
hab_terms  <- c("elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop", "tree_cover", "shrubland",
                "grassland", "water_rivers_dist", "cropland_dist", "urban_dist")
dist_terms <- c("road_dist", "fence_dist")

fit_one <- function(terms, d) {
  f <- reformulate(c(terms, sprintf("strata(%s)", STRATA_COL)), response = "case_")
  clogit(f, data = d, model = FALSE)
}

tidy_ci <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients; ci <- confint(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(s), coef = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"],
         exp_coef = exp(s[, "coef"]), lo95 = exp(ci[, 1]), hi95 = exp(ci[, 2]), p = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}

results <- list()
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n== fitting", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))

  # which crossing terms have enough data this season
  cs <- cross_summary |> filter(season == s)
  enough <- function(t) isTRUE(cs$n_cross_used[cs$term == t] >= MIN_USED_CROSS)
  cross_terms <- c("road_cross", "river_cross", if (enough("fence_cross")) "fence_cross")
  cat("Crossing terms used:", paste(cross_terms, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  if (!enough("ephemeral_cross")) warning("Too few ephemeral crossings in ", s)

  base <- c(hab_terms, dist_terms, cross_terms)
  specs <- list(
    `1. base (new fences, vector crossings)` = base,
    `2. + eph dist`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist"),
    `3. + eph prox`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox"),
    `4. + eph dist + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_cross"),
    `5. + eph prox + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross")
  )
  fits <- map(specs, fit_one, d = d)

  aic_tab <- tibble(season = s, model = names(fits),
                    AIC = map_dbl(fits, AIC), BIC = map_dbl(fits, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))

  # step-length check on the best ephemeral model
  best_eph <- aic_tab |> filter(model != names(specs)[1]) |> slice_min(AIC) |> pull(model)
  m_sl  <- fit_one(c(specs[[best_eph]], "sl_m", "log_sl_m"), d)
  shift <- tidy_ci(fits[[best_eph]]) |> select(term, coef, se) |>
    inner_join(tidy_ci(m_sl) |> select(term, coef_sl = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_move_se = (coef_sl - coef) / se)

  results[[s]] <- list(aic = aic_tab,
                       coefs = imap_dfr(fits, ~ tidy_ci(.x) |> mutate(model = .y, season = s)),
                       shift = shift, best_eph = best_eph)
  rm(d, fits, m_sl); gc()
}
saveRDS(results, here("outputs", "kaza_ssf_v2_results.rds"))
```

## Results

```{r results}
aic_all <- map_dfr(results, "aic"); print(aic_all)

# the terms the team asked about
map_dfr(results, "coefs") |>
  filter(str_detect(term, "ephemeral|fence|river_cross|road_cross")) |>
  arrange(season, model, term) |> print(n = Inf)

# step-length robustness: |shift| < 2 SE = robust
map_dfr(results, "shift") |> filter(str_detect(term, "cross|ephemeral")) |> print(n = Inf)

# do the habitat coefficients move when ephemeral terms are added? (base vs best)
map_dfr(names(results), function(s) {
  cf <- results[[s]]$coefs
  inner_join(cf |> filter(model == "1. base (new fences, vector crossings)") |> select(term, coef, se),
             cf |> filter(model == results[[s]]$best_eph) |> select(term, coef_eph = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_se = (coef_eph - coef) / se)
}) |> filter(term %in% hab_terms) |> arrange(desc(abs(shift_se))) |> print()
```

  for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {

    m$residuals <- m$linear.predictors <- NULL   # drop the 4M-length vectors; coefs and vcov stay
    saveRDS(m, here("outputs", sprintf("kaza_ssf_v2_model5_%s.rds", s)))
    rm(d, m); gc()
